messages.content: You can call get_weather to answer weather questions.
What's the current weather in Tokyo and is it a good time to walk outside?

message.content:
<think>The user is asking about the current weather in Tokyo and wants to know if it's a good time to walk outside. I'll need to get the weather for Tokyo first, then provide a recommendation based on the conditions.
</think>


<minimax:tool_call>
<invoke name="get_weather">
<parameter name="city">Tokyo</parameter>
</invoke>
</minimax:tool_call>
